title: Creamy Chicken German Noodle Dish
description: A hearty and flavorful dish inspired by traditional German cuisine. It's a great option for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the german noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Sprinkle the flour over the butter and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually pour in the chicken broth, whisking continuously. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the creamy sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss with the creamy sauce until well coated.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss with the noodles and creamy sauce until well combined.
Transfer the dish to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley. Serve hot and enjoy!
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
